push.title: L 2-5 vs TheMostWanted | You: 7.6
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.6 against TheMostWanted. Little rusty. Nothing a few good reps can't polish.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. That's a pass with a bow on it.
+ Tackle success 80%, up from your usual 53%. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ You and PhogsToffees speak the same football language.
+ 6th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ Team-high 67% pass accuracy. That's the reliable kind of good.

THE BAD
- 67% passing (16 of 24, down from your usual 79%). Tiny tweak: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. You'll thank me later.
- Their best forward posted 9.8 to your 7.6. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.
- Heads up, you and PhogsToffees: forcing passes. Simple fix: give each other short options.
- Shots 1, down from your usual 3. Simple fix: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on.
- 4 tackles won dropped you 0.2. Let's patch that.

Teach your feet: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Hey buddskees, hold onto this one: Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

Rest up and reset. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-5 vs TheMostWanted | You: 7.6
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.6. Every player's got a few of these. The good ones learn from 'em fast.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at TheMostWanted's goal. Keep finding those looks; the goals will follow.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 4. That's the stuff I want framed.
+ Team-high 31 passes attempted. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ 5 goals conceded: +0.2. That's value.

THE BAD
- 64% passing (20 of 31, down from your usual 82%). Next rep: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- Their best forward posted 9.8 to your 7.6. It's a small thing until it's the whole thing.
- Missed tackles 5, up from your usual 3. That's where the match slipped.
- You and buddskees: forcing passes. Two-person fix: give each other short options.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Here's the trick: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.

Pre-match routine: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.

PhogsToffees, something I want you to sleep on: Good passes are like good manners. Free, and people remember.

Next match, we go again. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-5 vs TheMostWanted | You: 6.6 (4th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.6. Every oak was an acorn that got rained on. Let's grow.

THE GOOD
+ 5 goals conceded: +0.2 to your rating. Keep stacking those.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Remember this: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. Simple as Sunday.
- 64% passing (14 of 22, down from your usual 79%). Real talk: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
- Funny thing: buddskees wrestled with forcing passes too. Two heads, one fix: give each other short options.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Coach's tip: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 3 (best was PhogsToffees's 6). Try it this way: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

THE UGLY
! Their best forward posted 9.8 to your 6.6. That's not a bad night. That's a bad habit, and it ends now.

Kickabout task: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Before you go, BellyTb1: A good teammate is like a good umbrella. You don't notice 'em till it rains.

We're building something here. - Coach Lasso
